title: People who say they worked on recovered craft

tellings.quote: I met people who claimed to have worked there or seen them.

plain: There are people who say they worked on crashed craft of unknown origin recovered by the US government, or at least saw them. Kevin Knuth, a guest billed in his episode as a whistleblower from NASA, the US space agency, says he has met such people himself, though he does not name them or say what they told him beyond that claim. If they were right, the government would be holding and studying such craft.
